description: This file defines tracing categories, utility functions, and classes related to logging and diagnostics within the WPEFramework project. It includes category definitions, helper classes for different trace types, and formatting utilities.

classes.name: Constructor
classes.description: Represents a trace message for constructor invocation, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: CopyConstructor
classes.description: Represents a trace message for copy constructor invocation, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: AssignmentOperator
classes.description: Represents a trace message for assignment operator invocation, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a trace message for destructor invocation, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: MethodEntry
classes.description: Logs entry into a method, derived from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

classes.name: MethodExit
classes.description: Logs exit from a method, derived from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Measures and logs the duration of an operation, derived from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Utility function for formatting strings, with overloads for string reference and return value.
